model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the negative log probability for per-specialty terms across six medical specialties, comparing a baseline model, Mistralv0.2-Base, with five fine-tuned versions: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The horizontal axis, labeled “Per-specialty terms,” lists the six specialties in order from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “Negative log probability,” is scaled linearly from -27 to -22, with tick marks at regular intervals of one unit. Each specialty has one bar representing the baseline model (Mistralv0.2-Base, light blue) and five stacked bars representing the fine-tuned models, each colored differently according to a legend: Cardio (light beige), Gastro (light orange), Infect (orange), Neuro (dark orange), Obstetrics (brown), and Pediatrics (dark brown). The bars are grouped by specialty, with the baseline bar consistently appearing on the left and the fine-tuned bars stacked to its right. The bars are not sorted by value; instead, they are presented in the order of the specialties listed on the x-axis. All bars extend downward from the horizontal axis, with longer bars indicating higher negative log probability values (i.e., less negative values). The baseline bar for “Cardio” is the longest (approximately -26.8), while the shortest bars are for “Neuro” and “Obstetrics” within their respective groups, reaching approximately -24.5. The fine-tuned bars for each specialty generally show a trend of decreasing length compared to the baseline bar, indicating lower negative log probability values. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, or annotations beyond their color coding and position.
